summary.text: David Taylor is the Republican incumbent for Ohio's 2nd District, an Ohio native who worked as an attorney in the Clermont County Prosecutor's Office and later as president of his family's business before winning the open seat in 2024. He serves on the Agriculture and Transportation and Infrastructure committees and is seeking a second term.

paragraphs.text: Born in Ohio in 1969; attended Amelia High School, according to his congressional biography.
Earned a bachelor's degree from Miami University in 1992 and a law degree from the University of Dayton School of Law.
Joined the Clermont County Prosecutor's Office after law school, where his congressional biography says he tried criminal cases.
Returned to work for his family's business, Sardinia Ready Mix, Inc., where he served as president, according to his congressional biography and Ballotpedia.
Won the open 2nd District seat in November 2024 (73.6% in the general election), succeeding Brad Wenstrup, and took office January 3, 2025.

Serves on the House Agriculture and Transportation and Infrastructure committees, where he is vice chairman of the Water Resources and Environment Subcommittee. Co-chairs the bipartisan Congressional Rural Broadband Caucus.
Lives in Clermont County with his wife, Charity; they have three daughters, according to his congressional biography.
